title: Spectral graphs persist in the saved-identity v7 document

installed_sdk.rationale: GraphSerializer::to_saved_document, to_saved_file, from_saved_document, inspect_document and diff_graph_documents now admit spectral graphs, including analysis declarations and the single-stream asset source; no public signature changes.
